ui.printersIntro: Configure receipt printing and the printers found on this network.
ui.receiptTextLivesInSales: The receipt header and footer are part of your till settings, where the ticket is printed from.
ui.receiptTextStranded: You typed this here before the receipt moved to the till settings, so it is not printed on anything. Move it over to use it:
ui.moveReceiptText: Move it to the receipt settings
ui.receiptTextMoved: Moved. Your receipt prints it from now on.
ui.errReceiptTextMove: The text could not be moved. Copy it into the receipt settings by hand.
ui.hardwareUnavailable: This device cannot reach printers from the browser. Install the ERPlora app on the device that is connected to the printer and open your business from there.
ui.noPrintersFound: No network printers (port 9100) were found on this subnet.
ui.warnA4Printer: This looks like an office (A4) printer and does not understand receipts. Tickets and kitchen orders need a thermal printer.
ui.addPrinterHint: If the search does not find your printer, type the IP address shown on its configuration sheet (hold the feed button while switching it on to print it).
ui.addPrinterAdded: Printer added. A test page was sent to it.
ui.errAddPrinterAddress: That is not a valid address. Type the IP as it appears on the printer sheet (for example 192.168.1.100) and a port between 1 and 65535.
ui.errAddPrinterUnreachable: No printer answered at {address}. Check that it is switched on, connected to the same network as this device, and that the IP and port are correct.
ui.errAddPrinter: Could not add the printer. Update the ERPlora app on this device and try again.
ui.queueAlertWaiting: {waiting} print jobs for {role} have been waiting {age}.
ui.queueAlertWaitingOne: 1 print job for {role} has been waiting {age}.
ui.queueNoDeviceInApp: No device is covering this role yet: give this role to a printer in the list below and this device will print it.
ui.queueNoDeviceInBrowser: No device for this role is connected: install the ERPlora app on the device that is connected to the printer and open your business from there.
ui.queueAllClear: All clear: the queue is empty and {n} devices are connected.
ui.queueAllClearOne: All clear: the queue is empty and 1 device is connected.
ui.queueAllClearNoHost: Nothing is waiting right now. No print device is connected: new jobs will stay in the queue until one connects.
ui.errQueueLoad: Could not read the print queue.
ui.jobDiscardTitle: Discard this job? It will not be printed, and the record stays.
ui.jobRetried: Sent back to the queue: the next device to connect will print it.
ui.jobDiscarded: Job discarded. It will not be printed and it no longer blocks its station.
ui.errJobNotRequeueable: Only a job that has given up can be sent back; this one is {status}.
ui.errJobNotRequeueableUnknown: Only a job that has given up can be sent back. The list has just been refreshed.
ui.errJobNotDiscardable: A job a printer is working on cannot be discarded; this one is {status}.
ui.errJobNotDiscardableUnknown: This job cannot be discarded any more. The list has just been refreshed.
ui.errJobGone: That job is no longer in this queue. The list has just been refreshed.
ui.errJobCapability: Printing permission has not been granted, so jobs cannot be moved yet.
ui.errJobForbidden: Only whoever manages the business can move jobs in the print queue.
ui.errJobAction: The job could not be moved. Try again in a moment.
